locations.title: 98 - Play-Money Shakedown
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until your objective is to visit the Odyssey.

**Tips:**

**Reward:**
- Your money back! Yippee!

locations.title: 99 - The Ultimate Plan
locations.description:

locations.title: 50 - The Entertainer's Throne
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style.

**Tips:**
- To successfully distract the crowd, sing a song.

**Reward:**
- Staminan Royale

locations.title: 51 - Rise of the Dragon
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style.

**Tips:**
- Be ready for a tough fight; bring some healing items.

**Reward:**
- N/A

locations.title: 52 - Be My Boyfriend!
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style.

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows:
  - "Pleased to meet you sir. I'm Goro Majima."
  - "I'm a dentist."
  - "We sat next to each other at a movie."
  - "She's so innocent and childlike."

**Reward:**
- Sprite Belt (accessory) - for four best answers chosen
- Fluorite x5 (crafting material) - for two or three best answers chosen
- Bulletproof Glass Amulet (accessory) - for one best answer chosen

locations.title: 53 - Man with a Stranger's Face
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style.

**Reward:**
- Sakura Storm (weapon)

locations.title: 54 - Disciple of the New Order
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style.

**Tips:**
- To avoid an extra fight, choose the correct actions & words:
  - "I want to join the Order of Munan Chohept Onast"
  - Call her Iori
  - Say it with the pose
  - "Onast"
  - "Shooreh Pippi"
  - "Circle with the Left Hand, Then Bring Palms Together"
  - "Munan Suzuki"

**Reward:**
- Crystal (crafting material) - if you got the answers right
- Traveler's Amulet (accessory)

locations.title: 55 - Calling the Future
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then use the [Save Point](#loc=939766)

**Tips:**
- Batteries can be purchased from [Don Quijote Sotenbori](#loc=939821)

**Reward:**
- New [Save Point](#loc=939825) available

locations.title: 56 - A Taxing Issue
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows:
  - "To provide public services"
  - "Tobacco"
  - "Gasoline"
  - "8%"

**Reward:**
- Primeval Spirit Stone (accessory) - for picking the best answers

locations.title: 57 - Crossed Words
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows:
  - "Mashed"
  - "Popcorn"
  - "Shoulder"
  - "Soy sauce"

**Reward:**
- Pearl x3 (crafting material) - for choosing the correct answers
- Quality Iron (crafting material) - for choosing the wrong answers

locations.title: 58 - Stadium Jumper Strut
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style

**Tips:**
- Invest in your skills to take the enemies down quickly

**Reward:**
- Encounter Finder (accessory)

locations.title: 62 - The ¥10 Million Drug Test
locations.description:

**Reward:**

locations.title: 63 - Errands on the Run
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style

**Tips:**
- Medical items can be purchased from [Daikoku Drugstore](#loc=939774)
- New shoes can be purchased from [Don Quijote Sotenbori](#loc=939821)

**Reward:**
- Erran-kun's services
- Emi / Erranda (Hostess) - after unlocking the cabaret minigame

locations.title: 64 - Toilet Talk
locations.description:

locations.title: 78 - The Doll Girl
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style,

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with the girl after this substory, purchase anything from the store.

**Reward:**
- Security Wallet (accessory) - after reaching the maximum friendship level
- Dolly (Hostess) - after unlocking the cabaret minigame

locations.title: 79 - Komian's Chef
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then order food at [Komian](#loc=939833).

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with the chef after this substory, purchase food and prepare to fish up an Eel, Turtle, and Salmon.

**Reward:**
- Trouble Finder (accessory) - after reaching maximum friendship level

locations.title: 80 - STIJL's Barkeep
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then order a drink at [Shot Bar STIJL](#loc=939783)

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with the bartender after this substory, purchase anything from the bar.
- When you're running the bar, these are the correct answers:
  - "Sherry casks"
  - "Ballantine's"
  - "Fruity aroma"

**Reward:**
- French wallet (gift) - if you chose the correct answers
- After reaching maximum friendship level and unlocking the cabaret minigame, speak to the bartender again to partner with [Shot Bar STIJL](#loc=939784).

locations.title: 81 - Gandhara's Clerk
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then watch any video at [Gandhara Sotenbori](#loc=939874)

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with the clerk after this substory, watch more videos.

**Reward:**
- After reaching maximum friendship level and unlocking the cabaret minigame, speak to the clerk to partner with [Gandhara](#loc=939720).

locations.title: 82 - Kyoko at SEGA HI-TECH LAND
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then play Space Harrier at [SEGA HI-TECH LAND Sotenbori](#loc=939791)

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with Kyoko after this substory, beat her high scores.

**Reward:**
- After reaching maximum friendship level and unlocking the cabaret minigame, speak to Kyoko to partner with [SEGA Hi-Tech Land](#loc=939792).

locations.title: 96 - Fei Hu's Training
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've completed your first weapon search, then speak to Fei Hu.

**Reward:**
- Fei Hu's Slugger style training unlocked

locations.title: 66 - Party at Maharaja
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Dance at [Maharaja Sotenbori](#loc=939862) three times, then speak to the woman that appears inside the club some time later.

**Tips:**
- The dance battle can be attempted on any difficulty.

**Reward:**
- N/A

locations.title: 67 - Disco Transformation
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [66 - Party at Maharaja](#loc=940097), then return to Maharaja some time later.

**Tips:**
- The dance battle can be attempted on any difficulty.

**Reward:**
- N/A

locations.title: 68 - Disco Dancing Goddess
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [67 - Disco Transformation](#loc=940098), then return to Maharaja some time later.

**Tips:**
- The dance battle can be attempted on any difficulty.
- Aim for as many extra steps as possible - but keep your combo going above all else.

**Reward:**
- Isobe Fan (cosmetic; only appears while dancing)
- Ms. Isobe (Hostess) - after unlocking the cabaret minigame

locations.title: 77 - Sotenbori's Mr. Libido
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Encounter Mr. Libido during the main story. 

**Tips:**
- To progress your friendship with Mr. Libido after this substory, watch unique videos at [Gandhara Sotenbori](#loc=939874).
- The drink he needs can be purchased from [Daikoku Drugstore](#loc=939774)

**Reward:**
- Incomparable Habu Drink now sold at Daikoku

locations.description:

**Tips:**
- Pistols can be acquired via [The Dragon & Tiger Sotenbori](#loc=939797)

locations.title: 76 - Sotenbori's Mr Moneybags
locations.description:

**Tips:**

**Reward:**

locations.title: 100 - Sotenbori in Peril
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete all of Majima's substories.

**Tips:**
- Stock up on HP & Heat consumables
- Bring plenty of weapons, e.g Zap Guns & Spicy Knives
- Level up as much as you can - remember that Kiryu can send Majima money via Mr. Moneybags
- Do not consume 'Staniman Spork' - it'll drain your health!

**Reward:**
- Amon Sunglasses (accessory)
